question: The mean proportion of 6 and 54 is:
solution:
Given:

Two numbers are 6 and 54

We have to find the mean proportion.

Formula used:

If One number is a and another is b

Then there mean proportion will be , ✓(a × b)

Calculation:

Two numbers are 6 and 54

Then there mean proportion will be 

✓(6 × 54)

⇒ 6 × 3

= 18

∴ The mean proportions of 6 and 54 is 18
